title: Heidi
author: Johanna Spyri
summary: After being orphaned, a young girl is sent to live with her gruff grandfather on a Swiss mountain, where she grows to love the alpine life. Later she is taken to a city and longs to return.
readIf: you want a warm, nostalgic read set in lovely mountain scenery.
skipIf: you find old-fashioned moralising and religious sentiment tiresome.

pairings.reason: Another orphan wins over a stern guardian in a beautifully described setting.
A child transformed by fresh air and nature, with more mystery.
A family-centred classic with the same warmth and moral heart, for slightly older readers.
